# raff_database (Data Source)

Reads an existing managed database by its short `database_id` or by `name`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `database_id` (String) Short database ID.
- `name` (String) Database name.

### Read-Only

- `connection_uri` (String, Sensitive)
- `database_name` (String)
- `engine` (String)
- `engine_version` (String)
- `host` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_free` (Boolean)
- `password` (String, Sensitive)
- `plan_id` (Number)
- `port` (Number)
- `public_connection_uri` (String, Sensitive)
- `public_host` (String)
- `public_port` (Number)
- `status` (String)
- `storage_gb` (Number)
- `username` (String)
